2026-09-26 status from scaladock-43:
- Header height is settable: LayoutSettings(headerPx = 28).
- Chrome icons are CSS -fx-shape on .dock-icon.<kind> (themeable).
- The owner approved ScalaFX moving to demo only, a JDK 22 + JavaFX 24.0.1 library CI job, LICENSE and CHANGELOG. In progress.
- Still open (nice-to-have): pane retention across load, F6 keyboard navigation between groups, and a tab context-menu hook.
